ai_tasks_one_owner.name: ai_tasks_one_owner
ai_tasks_one_owner.value:
(
        ("ai_tasks"."quest_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("ai_tasks"."routine_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("ai_tasks"."boss_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
      ) = 1

bosses_result_seen_at.name: bosses_result_seen_at
bosses_result_seen_at.value: "bosses"."result_seen_at" IS NULL OR "bosses"."result" IS NOT NULL

bosses_result_xp_change.name: bosses_result_xp_change
bosses_result_xp_change.value: "bosses"."result" IS NOT NULL OR "bosses"."xp_change" IS NULL

quests_completion.name: quests_completion
quests_completion.value:
(
        (
          "quests"."completed_on" IS NULL
          AND "quests"."gold" IS NULL
          AND "quests"."xp" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "quests"."completed_on" IS NOT NULL
          AND "quests"."gold" IS NOT NULL
          AND "quests"."xp" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )
